# Code of Conduct

Effective date: `31 Aug 2021`

## Our Commitment

This project is maintained as a respectful and professional collaboration space.
All participants are expected to communicate with clarity, courtesy, and good
faith.

## Expected Behavior

- Be respectful in discussions, reviews, and issue reports
- Focus feedback on the work, not on the person
- Protect private or sensitive information
- Help keep the project safe, inclusive, and productive

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, threats, or discrimination of any kind
- Personal attacks, intimidation, or repeated hostile behavior
- Sharing private information without permission
- Disruptive conduct that blocks healthy collaboration

## Enforcement

Project maintainers may moderate, edit, or remove content that violates this
code of conduct. Serious or repeated violations may result in contribution
restrictions or removal from project spaces.

Reports should be submitted through the repository's official communication
channels so they can be reviewed privately.

## Scope

This code applies to repository discussions, pull requests, issue threads, and
other official spaces used to collaborate on this project.
